observed.coreBuild: Mihomo Meta v1.19.29 windows amd64 with go1.26.5 with_gvisor
observed.method: raw HTTP Upgrade via node, plus a local origin server behind the mixed port; no external network involved
observed.authentication: Authorization: Bearer <secret> header only; ?secret=<x> query param returns 401 on both REST and WebSocket; no credentials returns 401
observed.frameOpcode: text (0x1) only; no ping/pong observed across 9s per stream
observed.cadence: one frame per second for /traffic, /connections and /memory; /logs is event driven and silent while the core is idle
notes: /traffic reports up/down as bytes transferred in the last interval (i.e. bytes per second) and upTotal/downTotal as cumulative bytes
/connections reports the same cumulative counters under the different key names downloadTotal/uploadTotal; both streams were observed to agree exactly (770 and 20874756)
/connections connections is null, not an empty array, when nothing is active, and is a full snapshot on every push
/logs frames carry no timestamp field, only type and payload; the client is responsible for stamping time
metadata ports are JSON strings, not numbers (sourcePort "57734", destinationPort "18081", inboundPort "17890")
metadata carries many fields the current client discards: inboundName, dnsMode, uid, process, processPath, remoteDestination, dscp, sniffHost, sourceIPASN, destinationIPASN
start is RFC3339 with a 7 digit fraction and a numeric timezone offset
chains is an array; providerChains is a parallel array whose entries may be empty strings
